scripts.dev: npm run build -w @feedback/ui && concurrently -k -n ui,api,web "npm run dev -w @feedback/ui" "npm run dev -w @feedback/api" "npm run dev -w @feedback/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @feedback/ui && npm run build -w @feedback/api && npm run build -w @feedback/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @feedback/ui && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @feedback/ui && npm run test:coverage -ws --if-present
